newsitem.title: USA: Area to buy Cardinal for $109 mln.
newsitem.headline: Area to buy Cardinal for $109 mln.

text.p: Area Bancshares Corp said Thursday it has signed a definitive agreement to buy Cardinal Bancshares Inc in a stock transaction valued at $109 million.

Under the terms of the deal Area will exchange 2.7391 shares of its common stock for each share of Cardinal common stock. Area said the deal repesents an exchange value of $60.26 for each share of Cardinal common stock.
It also said the purchase price would be 1.88 times Cardinal's March 31, 1997 book value.
The companies said the deal will be accounted for as a pooling of interests and is expected to be consummated in the fourth quarter of 1997 pending necessary approvals.
